title: A line whose part became inactive still works, but cannot switch to it
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. An open work order (or estimate) with a line whose part you will deactivate.
custom_steps:
1. Add a part to an open work order line, then deactivate that part.
  2. Confirm the existing line stays and its totals keep calculating; change its quantity, price and line notes.
  3. Try to swap another line onto the now-inactive part via normal lookup.
  4. Convert the work order to an invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If a part is set inactive while it sits on an open work order or estimate, the existing line stays and its totals keep calculating, and the user can still change that line's quantity, price and notes.
  • The user cannot swap another line onto an inactive part through normal lookup, and converting a work order to an invoice succeeds when a line references a part that became inactive after it was added.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 9 (Inactive parts cannot be selected); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E1: “If a part is set inactive while it already sits on an open work order or estimate, the existing line stays and its totals keep calculating.”
  • S9-E2: “The user can still change the quantity, price and line notes on an existing line whose part has since become inactive.”
  • S9-E3: “The user cannot swap another line onto an inactive part through normal lookup.”
  • S9-E4: “Converting a work order to an invoice succeeds when a line references a part that became inactive after it was added.”
